additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421991-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R5 313057100006]upgrade the firmware CRM:02681000135
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
We have been handed the case over from our global support team.
They have sent through the Configuration and Firmware via Secufex, which will time out 13/05/2025 after which they will no longer be available.
I will ensure they are also downloaded, in the event it is missed or the files appear corrupted on download.
As Glen has undertaken the process of CFast card and USB preparation before, we are happy to assist additionally to help speed up the process if needed, at a billable rate.
Once the CFast card with the new firmware is ready and the USB prepared with the new configuration, you can process to the chargers themselves.
The process would be as following:
Ensure that the Serial number matches the intended configuration loaded onto the USB.
With the charger energised (but all covers in place)
Unlock door panel cover for the door switch and open the door
Set PLC “KF1” to “Stop” via the toggle button position
The press the digital fuse “FC12” which will cause the charger to shutdown
Remove the CFast card from KF1 PLC (just above the “run, stop, reset” toggle switch there is a cover over the CFast card that can be opened).
Insert the correctly labelled (by serial number) USB (live linux) into the KF1 PLC
Set KF1 PLC to “run” on the toggle switch
Power on the charger again by pressing FC12
The charger will then boot from the USB and then will eventually prompt for the CFast Card to be installed
Install the new CFast Card into the charger
After the charger reaches 30% on the screen, you can remove the USB and close the charger door
We can then see if the charger boots up completely and verify connection on SCB
If you require any additional information, please let me know.
If prefered this process can be run through via a remote team's session with us and then repeated (with different configuration files) on the other chargers.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
